# What does that part actually cost you to make?

> Free CNC machining quote calculator for job shops: real cost per part from yield, cycle time, setup and tooling, plus break-even price at lots of 1 to 500.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cnc-machining-quote-calculator/)

- [This calculator vs. quoting in a spreadsheet](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cnc-machining-quote-calculator/vs-quoting-in-a-spreadsheet.html)
